issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify Milkable.messageOnMilk() as a no-argument method returning a String (e.g., "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"). The solution repository instead defines Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume) (accepting a double parameter) and implements it in Seal and Goat. The template/Main and problem examples call messageOnMilk() with no arguments. This parameter mismatch between the specification and the solution will confuse students about the expected interface signature and return value format and prevents a straightforward implementation following the spec.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem specification: change Milkable to declare String messageOnMilk() with no parameters, and update Seal and Goat to implement the no-arg method returning the exact format "[Animal Type] [name] is milked". Alternatively, if a volume parameter is intentional, update the problem statement and UML to specify messageOnMilk(double volume) and adjust examples accordingly; prefer updating the solution to match the current spec to avoid confusing students.

issues.description: The problem statement and template expect a no-argument Milkable.messageOnMilk() that returns a string like "[Animal Type] [name] is milked", but the solution defines Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume) (and Seal/Goat implementations use the volume parameter and include it in the return string). This signature/name mismatch prevents a straightforward mapping from the task description and template Main usage (which calls messageOnMilk() with no arguments) to the solution, and will confuse students and cause compilation/usage inconsistencies.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across artifacts. Recommended: update the solution to match the problem/template by changing Milkable to declare String messageOnMilk() (no parameters) and adjust Seal and Goat implementations to return "[Animal Type] [name] is milked". Alternatively, if volume is intended, update the problem statement and template Main usage to specify and call messageOnMilk(double volume) consistently.
